summary: Update on US conspiracy broadcaster Alex Jones: his Infowars coverage of COVID-19, January 6 and Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and the Sandy Hook defamation suits over his promotion of harassment of grieving families, as of 2022.

evidence.note: start of long segment on Jones's early COVID-19 bioweapon claims and product sales
January 6 segment: lead-up rallies, guests urging a Capitol occupation, Infowars coverage
Ukraine segment: Jones's pro-Putin predictions and atrocity denial
Sandy Hook suits in Texas and Connecticut, plus Gilmore and Fontaine cases
2017 Shroyer video on Neil Heslin, re-aired by Jones, opened the Texas case
Infowars promoted Halbig's harassment of Newtown families after 2012
Infowars corporate representatives' failed depositions led to default judgments
extended segment on Owen Shroyer's own deposition
2022 coda: bankruptcy filing postponed the Texas trial

notes: Guests named only as Dan and Jordan of Knowledge Fight; surnames from general knowledge. No theme for litigation/defamation, so the legal half maps only to conspiracy-theories. Ukraine coverage (~15 min) was left out of themes/setting since events happen on Jones's US show. main_span end null as Jones was active at release.
